note: docs/163 NoStart sync-plan callers (2026-10-22): three day verify jobs (8 + 5 + 5 min, counters show the fixes acting, no crash), then clean-night both-order pairs judged on hitches (tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts) on SV big crowd and BP route bits (10 min each), ~1 h 40 min. Only the two new ts3fixes switches (stuckchecknear, failrepeat); LogFallbackStack=16 in every job so the multi-second NoStart plans finally carry their managed callers. Before: build and install ts3fixes and ts3agent from this branch; game-copy/ts3native.asi.0325 present. Groups for --only / --from: *-verify-*, sv-nostart-crowd-*, bp-nostart-routebits-*.

jobs.note: docs/163 (NoStart callers). ts3native 0325 at release defaults (only the two log keys and HitchAttr set); ts3fixes + ts3agent built from this branch (node tools/setup/build-fixes.ts; node tools/harness/build-agent.ts), every other switch at master tuning. CORRECTNESS, daytime and noisy machine OK, 8 min (the clock jump plus 240 s for the 20-60 sim-minute stuck-check alarms; 5 min can end before they fire). Both new switches on for the whole run. Pass: no crash, game alive, 0 watchdog lines, stuckchecknear_checks >= 1 (fixesRequire), stuckchecknear_plans <= 10 x checks; Sims reset by the check compare with bp-sca-off (stuckcheck-async.json) within seed drift. Target: player-noticeable hitches, not speed. Read first: tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts (p99, p99.9, max, counts >= 100/300/500/1000 ms, both-order pair means); then (node tools/harness/nostart-report.ts --filter nostart-fix-ab --jobs, TS3_REPO=<main checkout> from a worktree): sync fallback plans count / sum / max ms and their callers (16-frame stacks: the first run that can name the multi-second NoStart callers, docs/163 §2), frames >= 300 ms, hitches/min; patches stuckchecknear_checks / _plans / _allfailed, failrepeat_recorded / _answered / _skipped_ms; watchdog resets and stuck list not above OFF.
